summary: Backend-only regression testing of regime dataset repair/exclusion logic for walk-forward (services/regime_lab._verify_or_repair, candle_cache.repair_gaps, research_dataset.verify_histories, regime_opt dataset_excluded). Ran the 4 pytest files requested: 41 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed.
critical_code_review_comments: test_regime_dataset_repair.py covers all four scenarios described in the review request (repair fills internal hole, single mismatch excluded, repair+verify keeps symbol, too many mismatches still aborts, verify_histories/min_verified semantics unchanged). Assertions confirm job['dataset_excluded'][0]['symbol']=='HYPEUSDT' and the German reason string 'Kerzenanzahl 290 ≠ Manifest 300', matching the production bug pattern for HYPEUSDT.
Frontend RegimeLab.js data-testid regime-wf-excluded-<scope> line not exercised (backend-only run as instructed) - safe to rely on code review per request.
test_credentials: Admin / Dean06Greif!/Admin - not needed, monkeypatch-based unit/integration tests
seed_data_creation: None - tests use in-memory monkeypatched candle_cache._MEM and fake histories
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regime walk-forward dataset repair/exclusion logic is verified. If further e2e coverage is desired, would need to POST /api/regime/* to create a small analysis, tamper the stored dataset manifest for one symbol in Mongo (regime_analyses collection), and hit the walk-forward endpoint expecting completion with dataset_excluded rather than a RuntimeError. Pre-existing failures in test_iter38_watchdog_pnl_playbook_api.py and test_e1_adaptive_multiasset forex are unrelated and were not run.
rca of the issue: Original bug: fetch_histories raised RuntimeError when any single symbol's cached 1m candle count diverged from the dataset manifest. Fix under test: services/regime_lab._verify_or_repair now (1) calls candle_cache.repair_gaps to backfill internal gaps and reloads/reverifies, (2) if still mismatching but >= min_verified (75% of manifest, min 2) verify, excludes the offending symbols into job['dataset_excluded'] and lets the walk-forward continue, (3) only raises the original RuntimeError when too few symbols verify. Tests confirm all three paths.
